description: [Merchant] Generate comprehensive documentation for payware API integration with quick start instructions, authentication flows, operation examples, error handling patterns, and language-specific integration guides.

language.description: Programming language to focus documentation on. Options: python (requests, virtual env), nodejs (npm, async/await), php (Composer, PSR), java (Maven/Gradle, Spring Boot), csharp (NuGet, ASP.NET Core), curl (command-line). Includes language-specific setup and patterns.

partner_type.description: Partner type determines documentation scope. merchant: transaction processing, product management, basic reporting. isv: all merchant features plus OAuth2 for multi-merchant management. payment_institution: transactions, advanced settlement.

name: payware_generate_documentation
